context.currentProblem: Single NestJS backend (apps/api) deployed as duplicate on both Vercel AND VM. 17 modules handle everything from billing to AI chat. Agent modules (chat, transcribe) can only run on VM because OpenClaw gateway and transcript files are local. Platform modules (billing UI, CRUD) don't need VM and could deploy cheaper/faster on Vercel serverless.
context.desiredState: Two independent backends: (1) apps/api stays on Vercel as Platform Backend handling billing, campaigns, funnels, leads, domains, themes, tags, segments, custom-fields, media, internal. (2) New apps/agent-api on VM handling chat, conversations, brain, transcribe — co-located with OpenClaw gateway. Frontend proxy routes requests to correct backend by path. Both authenticate via Supabase JWT independently. Both access same Supabase DB directly.
context.architectureGoal: Separation of concerns. Agent backend scales independently on VM. Platform backend is stateless on Vercel. No inter-service HTTP calls. Database is single source of truth for shared data (credits, brain, conversations).

decisions.agentDeploy: Hetzner VM via PM2 (co-located with OpenClaw gateway on port 18789)
decisions.authPattern: Both backends validate Supabase JWT independently — no shared auth service needed
decisions.creditsPattern: Direct Supabase access. Agent Backend has lightweight CreditsGuard (Supabase balance query) + full CreditsService (reads OpenClaw transcript files from VM filesystem, calculates cost, deducts credits). Platform Backend has CreditsService for balance display + StripeService for payments. NOTE: CreditsService uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY — this is a SANCTIONED EXCEPTION to the RLS-only rule because credit operations span multiple tables (monthly_credit_usage, credit_purchases, ai_usage_events, user_subscriptions, user_trials, subscription_plans) and need cross-user atomic writes that RLS cannot scope correctly.
decisions.brainPattern: Brain module exists in BOTH backends. Platform Backend: Brain controllers (UI endpoints for graph, memories, snapshots) + Brain services. Agent Backend: Brain services only (no controllers, just imported by ChatModule for AI context).
decisions.communicationPattern: Zero inter-service HTTP calls. Both backends talk to Supabase directly. Frontend decides which backend to call based on URL path.

modules: BillingModule (Stripe webhooks, balance display, plans, credit packs)
BrainModule (UI controllers: graph, memories, snapshots, emotional)
ChatModule (OpenClaw proxy, artifact extraction, response filtering)
BrainModule (services only — MemoriesService, EmbeddingService, ConversationProcessingService, EmotionalTaggingService for AI context)
additionalServices: CreditsService (full — reads OpenClaw transcripts from filesystem, calculates cost, deducts)
